about.sectionSubtitle: Engineering philosophy, product ownership, and technical mentorship

whatIDo.title: Engineering & Advisory Pillars
items: End-to-End Product Ownership: Taking products and web platforms from initial concept to live production—architecture, interface design, deployment, and continuous operation.
Enterprise Identity & Access Architecture: Designing privileged access management, Just-In-Time approval workflows, and multi-directory self-service systems built for enterprise scale.
DevSecOps & Workflow Automation: Publishing official CI/CD secrets plugins and building automation platforms that eliminate repetitive manual operations.
Developer Mentorship & Project Guidance: Coaching junior engineers, evaluating hackathon prototypes as a jury member, and guiding student and product teams through complex builds.

bio.title: Software Engineer · Product Builder · Mentor
paragraphs: I design and ship software that holds up in the real world. At Securden, I architect the privileged access, password self-service, and CI/CD secrets infrastructure that enterprise organizations trust to protect their most sensitive credentials across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace.

Alongside enterprise security engineering, I have been launching and operating my own software products and client platforms since 2020—including a multi-tenant headless CMS, a collaborative household finance platform, commercial brand websites, and institutional management portals.

Just as important to me is paying that experience forward. I mentor junior developers in production environments, guide student innovators through national hackathons and flagship builds, and speak at engineering colleges on building resilient, concurrent systems.

experience.sectionSubtitle: Mission-critical platforms, commercial launches, and engineering teams I have built with

jobs.title: Enterprise Identity, PAM & DevSecOps Infrastructure
jobs.description: Privileged Access Management · Multi-Directory Identity · CI/CD Secrets Ecosystem
achievements: Architected and shipped an enterprise Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) platform from the ground up with multi-directory support and high-availability design.
Engineered core Password Vault workflows including Just-In-Time (JIT) privileged access, multi-stage approval engines, and policy-driven access controls.
Built deep identity provider integrations across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace for seamless directory synchronization and lifecycle management.
Built and published official secrets management plugins for CI/CD and infrastructure automation pipelines, enabling zero-plaintext credential retrieval.
Upgraded the encrypted browser autofill extension ecosystem and created custom bundling tooling to eliminate external runtime dependencies.

jobs.title: SaaS Platform Architecture, Web Rebuilds & Developer Mentorship
jobs.description: SaaS Platforms · Legacy Website Modernization · Engineering Mentorship
achievements: Led and mentored junior developers to deliver scalable production systems, instilling strong architectural practices and hands-on ownership.
Architected and co-built a custom internal project management platform alongside mentees, replacing third-party tools while providing real-world product delivery experience.
Spearheaded the ground-up rebuild and launch of legacy client software and websites, modernizing the user experience and operational reliability.
Designed and shipped core operational workflows for a high-traffic SaaS platform and a comprehensive Student Management System.

jobs.title: Client Web Platforms & Brand Website Launches
jobs.description: Commercial Web Applications · Brand Sites · Product Discovery
achievements: Drove consumer-facing web applications and custom client platforms from initial market feasibility and product scoping through live production launch.
Built, modernized, and launched multiple brand websites and digital interfaces with a focus on performance and user experience.
Delivered tailored software solutions for clients across education and commercial sectors.
